Execute the supplied Rego v0 admission policy on the supplied input and base data.
Evaluate the query data.k8suniqueserviceselector.violation. HOLD means one or more violation objects; ALLOW means zero violation objects.
Return exactly one JSON object with these fields:
- "action": "ALLOW" or "HOLD"
- "violation_count": the exact number of distinct violation objects
- "subject": the reviewed object as {"kind", "namespace", "name"}
- "rule_id": "UNIQUE_SERVICE_SELECTOR" for HOLD and "NONE" for ALLOW
- "witnesses": one {"kind", "namespace", "name"} object per violation; use kind FlexVolume, namespace "", and the volume name for FlexVolume witnesses
Use the policy, input, and base data as the complete execution state.

POLICY SOURCE
package k8suniqueserviceselector

make_apiversion(kind) = apiVersion {
  g := kind.group
  v := kind.version
  g != ""
  apiVersion = sprintf("%v/%v", [g, v])
}

make_apiversion(kind) = apiVersion {
  kind.group == ""
  apiVersion = kind.version
}

identical(obj, review) {
  obj.metadata.namespace == review.namespace
  obj.metadata.name == review.name
  obj.kind == review.kind.kind
  obj.apiVersion == make_apiversion(review.kind)
}

flatten_selector(obj) = flattened {
  selectors := [s | s = concat(":", [key, val]); val = obj.spec.selector[key]]
  flattened := concat(",", sort(selectors))
}

violation[{"msg": msg}] {
  input.review.kind.kind == "Service"
  input.review.kind.version == "v1"
  input.review.kind.group == ""
  input_selector := flatten_selector(input.review.object)
  other := data.inventory.namespace[namespace][_][_][name]
  not identical(other, input.review)
  other_selector := flatten_selector(other)
  input_selector == other_selector
  msg := sprintf("same selector as service <%v> in namespace <%v>", [name, namespace])
}

INPUT JSON
{"review":{"kind":{"group":"","kind":"Service","version":"v1"},"name":"kubernetes","namespace":"default","object":{"apiVersion":"v1","kind":"Service","metadata":{"name":"kubernetes","namespace":"default"},"spec":{"clusterIP":"10.43.0.1","ports":[{"name":"https","port":443,"protocol":"TCP","targetPort":6443}],"sessionAffinity":"None","type":"ClusterIP"}}}}
